empty.title: Maps that work anywhere
empty.body: Download the world map and the regions you need. They keep working with no signal.

location.deniedBody: Allow location access in Settings to see where you are on the map. It works offline using GPS.
location.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. Try again outdoors.

regions.title: Offline maps
regions.worldBody: Countries, cities and main roads, down to zoom {{zoom}}. Shown under your regions.
regions.visibleAreaBody: Save exactly what's on screen now
regions.none: No regions yet. Pick one or download the area you're looking at.
regions.deleteBody: It frees {{size}}. You can download it again later.

zoomHint.12: Towns, main roads and land use. Smallest download.
zoomHint.14: Every street and path. Good for walking and driving.
zoomHint.15: Buildings and full detail. Largest download.

download.notEnough: Not enough space: you need {{needed}} and have {{free}} free.
download.tooLarge: This area is too big for this detail level. Choose less detail or a smaller area.
download.offline: You need an internet connection to download maps. Downloaded maps then work offline.

markers.title: Saved places
markers.emptyBody: Long-press anywhere on the map to drop a pin.
